name: Konami VRC4e/VRC4f

components.role: VRC4 ASIC with mapper-23 A0/A1 package wiring, 8 KiB PRG banking, 1 KiB CHR banking, CIRAM routing and IRQ control
Reusable Konami VRC 8-bit reload/counter and 341-dot prescaler circuitry

connections: mapper.PrgBank0/1 + PrgMode -> PrgRom bank address inputs
notes: NES 2.0 submapper 1 selects VRC4f wiring and submapper 2 selects VRC4e wiring. Submapper 3 identifies VRC2b and is intentionally rejected by this VRC4 package. Legacy iNES mapper 23 uses the VRC4e/VRC4f address-line OR compatibility decode.
